status: research-only; survived two materially different owner rewrite waves; still falsifiable and not a universal template
goal: Minimize the distance from first encounter to correct causal prediction/action without moving factual authority or flattening exact technical reference.

readerJobs.question: What is this, why does it exist, what is current, and where do I go next?
Why does the system behave this way and what responsibility boundaries matter?
How do I accomplish one concrete goal safely?
readerJobs.feynmanPressure: medium; context only as needed for the action

readerJobs.question: What is the exact field, command, contract, capability, or requirement?
Why do we believe this, what was tested, and what remains uncertain?
readerJobs.feynmanPressure: result-first, but derivation may remain detailed

disciplines.rule: Choose the reader job before choosing prose form. Do not make one page optimize orientation, explanation, action, exact lookup, and historical derivation at once.
On orientation/explanation surfaces, put the real problem, decision, or current answer before project taxonomy, phase codes, or derivation.
disciplines.failureProtected: Reader must reverse-engineer why the project exists from inventories or research chronology.

disciplines.rule: When responsibility changes what can be inferred, write the responsible actor/owner as the subject and state the scope of proof or completion. Add a compact negative-proof sentence when a nearby stronger inference would change action.
disciplines.failureProtected: Proof→meaning, persistence→ownership, capability→authority, or local-completion→domain-completion overreach.

disciplines.rule: Before a large capability list, show one normal journey or one failure/counterfactual that crosses the important responsibility boundary. Examples earn space only when they change prediction or action.
disciplines.failureProtected: Abstract nouns are individually defined but the reader cannot reconstruct system behavior.

disciplines.rule: State what is current and which exact owner source/revision can prove it before target/research/history. Revalidate currentness again at publication: an active owner mutation or changed authority document blocks stale summaries even when the prose was correct at its original parent.
disciplines.failureProtected: Current/target/history confusion, publication lag, and publishing a correct-at-parent explanation after owner truth has already started moving.

disciplines.rule: Keep entry/explanation compact and progressively disclose exact contracts, commands, requirements, research evidence, and history through owner-native links. Preserve stable public headings/navigation anchors when the owner repository itself treats them as an interface, but do not confuse those anchors with a universal prose template. A link is revision-bound navigation, not timeless currentness; revalidate linked authority before publication. Foreign-repository style/lint rules remain non-authoritative unless explicitly promoted.
disciplines.failureProtected: Second factual authority, stale duplicated prose or links, breaking owner-native navigation/checker interfaces for aesthetics, and accidental cross-owner style governance.

disciplines.rule: End important entry surfaces with reader-specific next paths and evaluate rewrites by stable reader-consequence tasks. Primary acceptance is causal correctness and absence of new authority/currentness over-inference. At equal correctness, use input/token burden as a deletion pressure: a material burden increase without decision gain triggers contraction review rather than a subjective clarity claim. Burden-neutral causal reorganization may be retained when it serves the reader job, but must not be reported as performance improvement. Transport failures are recovered only by exact replay of the missing frozen trial; do not mass-rerun or repair the oracle after results.
disciplines.failureProtected: Beautiful prose without decision gain, invalid paired comparisons, hidden context inflation, post-hoc evaluator repair, and duplicated trials after transport failure.

sentenceDefaults: Prefer active voice when actor/owner identity matters.
Use second person and imperative mood for reader instructions; conceptual prose may use owner/project subjects instead.
Put material conditions before the action they constrain.
Lead sections and headings with the important concept; keep paragraphs bounded enough to scan.
Use one term for one responsibility where possible; do not create synonyms merely for stylistic variety.
antiRules: No mandatory seven-question checklist in reader or Agent context.
No phase-code-first entry when the retained result can be stated first.
No conversion of reference/contracts into story prose merely for consistency.
No copied current fact when an owner link can carry the exact technical detail.
No generated/public projection promoted into owner truth.
No human-comprehension claim from Agent or browser evidence.
No foreign repository lint/style configuration promoted into a cross-owner semantic publication gate.
No paired rewrite task whose correct factual answer is intentionally changed by creating/removing the documentation surface itself.
No forced main/ref update through an actively dirty owner worktree merely to make documentation publication look complete.
No removal of owner-native stable public headings merely to make prose more literary when the owner checker/navigation contract depends on them.
No acceptance of a causally correct rewrite with materially higher reader burden when the extra text buys no frozen decision benefit; contract it and retest.
No claim that every successful rewrite must be shorter; burden-neutral reorganization can be valid, but it is not a performance win.
No mass rerun of completed paired trials after one transport failure; replay only the exact missing frozen trial and retain the failed evidence.
reopen: Revise the discipline only when a real owner rewrite shows a repeated failure that these heuristics cause or fail to protect; do not elaborate it for taxonomy completeness.
